author: kycrafft
body:
The next time there is an xp reset (never? XD) it would be really cool to add a base xp filter for the leaderboards. This counts the amount of xp gained minus the donator bonus. 
It is not affected by a rank change. So if you have emerald and get diamond, your base xp just switches from being 1/2 the xp you actually earn to 2/5
This is could be useful for players to judge themselves against others of different ranks. Say a gold wants to compare stats with an emerald or something.
